UserMessage(content=[ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id='toolu_01NJHpKdZ4gN4qmSbEAvtpir', content='The flags will have two color indicators next to the checkbox. AssistantMessage(content=[TextBlock(text='## Diagnosis\n\nThe defect was in `UriPartsModule` (`app/src/main/java/com/trianguloy/urlchecker/modules/list/UriPartsModule.java`), in how the query was parsed and rebuilt:\n\n```java\nurlQuerySanitizer.parseQuery(uri.getQuery());      // (1)\n...\nbuilder.appendQueryParameter(name, value);          // (3)\n```\n\n1. `uri.getQuery()` returns the query **already decoded** (UTF‑8).\n2. `UrlQuerySanitizer.parseQuery(...)` then unescapes **a second time**, and its internal `unescape()` builds a char per byte (`(char) 0xE6`), i.e. Latin‑1, not UTF‑8.\n3. The decoded (now corrupted) text is **re‑encoded** as UTF‑8 when rebuilding the url.\n\nFor `prefill_%25E6%259D%25A5%25E6%25BA%2590` this gives exactly the reported symptoms:\n`%25E6…` → (1) `prefill_%E6%9D%A5%E6%BA%90` → (2) `prefill_æ¥æº` (mojibake shown) → (3) `prefill_%C3%A6%C2%9D%C2%A5%C3%A6%C2%BA%C2%90` (broken url). The same double decode/re-encode also corrupted the path segments.\n\n## Fix\n\n- The query (and the paths) are now taken **encoded** (`getEncodedQuery()` / `getEncodedPath()`), split on `&` / `/`, and each part is decoded **exactly once and as UTF‑8** only for display.\n- When a part is removed, the url is rebuilt with `encodedQuery()` / `encodedPath()` from the untouched **raw** parts, so they are never re-encoded: deleting one parameter can no longer alter any other part of the url.\n- Added a tolerant decoder: escapes are accumulated as bytes and decoded together as UTF‑8 (multi-byte characters work); a lone `%` or any non‑UTF‑8 byte sequence is left as-is instead of becoming `\\uFFFD` garbage. User info and fragment use it too, for consistency.\n\nVerified against the reported url (logic exercised standalone on the JDK): the parameter now displays as `prefill_%E6%9D%A5%E6%BA%90 -> 帮助与反馈` (no mojibake), and removing `hide` yields `https://example.com?prefill_%25E6%259D%25A5%25E6%25BA%2590=%E5%B8%AE%E5%8A%A9%E4%B8%8E%E5%8F%8D%E9%A6%88`, i.e. the original url minus that parameter, byte for byte, instead of the broken one.
